scope: Historical action WebSocket scanning checks wall and monotonic expiry on opening, messages and settlement; expired streams cannot return predecessor evidence.
coverage: Real localhost WebSocket server sends actions after mocked forward wall, monotonic, or backwards-wall/monotonic expiry, without waiting for the real timeout callback.
Each expired scan rejects and a fresh scan succeeds.
Existing real-socket budget, cancellation, timeout and malformed/history-order cases still pass.
limits: History is source-reported, not authenticated completeness or inclusion evidence.
No physical suspend, live indexer, browser/full-workspace regression or new runtime image.
Synchronous parsing and socket callbacks are not preempted.
